_source: Verbatim Thai keys from pototype/boq-list.jsx BOQList (L64-211) + NewBOQForm (L226-386) + the ds.jsx STATUS labels (L84-92) the prototype's <StatusBadge> renders. Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so Thai never appears in .tsx/.ts source — same pattern as cc-strings.json / project-strings.json. Each value is a real i18n key: navBoqList is the 'BOQ List' nav_i18n label (tn); every other value is a phrases key (tp) that has NO dedicated dict key (the boq.list* DICT keys cover the rest of the screen and are used via t()). status* are the four ds.jsx STATUS.<status>.label strings.
